perks: Puzzles drawn from your own mistakes

cta.title: Don't Stay Rooky ! Become the King !

hero.lead: A path for each cognitive skill, sessions tailored to you, profs who help you and bosses who challenge you.

modules.title: Twenty-odd modules. Endless settings.
modules.lead: Every module has its settings: length, themes, level, colour, mode. You never play the same session twice, unless you want to.

auto.title: Your Lichess account, linked in one click.
auto.quote: With your Lichess games, I prepare your repertoire and a session tailored to you.
auto.note: Early access: an invitation key is required to sign up. Already signed up with Lichess? You go straight to the generation.
points: Your repertoire drawn from your most played moves
A session built from your last 200 games
Your Lichess rating curve on your dashboard

paths.title: Six skills to train. A path for each one.
paths.chapterText: Mates on a frozen board: calculate the whole line, then play it in one go, both sides.

sessions.title: Your session, built your way.
sessions.lead: Pick your modules, set each one up and play them in a row. Or let your profs prepare it from your games.

versus.title: Some help you. Others challenge you.
versus.more: And also the Metronome, the Cyclops and other guardians to discover.

woodpecker.title: The same set, faster every time.
woodpecker.lead: Solve your set, then start over in shorter and shorter cycles. The grid keeps track of every puzzle: fast, solved, with help or missed.
